name: Script-to-Shader SDF Preprocessor
definition: A C++ function that parses a custom script language to generate GLSL code for SDF scene composition, including loops, boolean operations, materials, and lights.
summary: The Script-to-Shader SDF Preprocessor is a C++ utility that generates GLSL fragment shaders from declarative scripts, distinguishing itself by operating at the source generation stage rather than producing volumetric data.
